{{Recipe summary
| Category = Potato recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients == 
* 2 medium [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], peeled
* 1 bunch of [[Cookbook:Green Onion|spring onions]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 100 g cooked lean [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] or 200 g [[Cookbook:Corned Beef|corned beef]] (optional), chopped very small and fine
* [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|Cheddar cheese]], grated
* 1 handful of [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]], chopped fine
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]

== Procedure ==
# Boil potatoes, then [[Cookbook:Mashing|mash]] them.
# Place the mashed potatoes in a bowl and add the spring onions, beef, cheese, the parsley, salt, and pepper. Mix together, then add the eggs and mix everything together.
# Heat some oil in a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]]. Add 3 large spoonfuls of the mixture to the frying pan, and flatten them out to around 1 cm thick. Cook until golden brown.
# Serve hot with salad and fresh buttered bread.
